expectations.text: Detects Python/Django — wiki.config.yaml lists language='python' and framework='django' with at least one evidence file cited in detection-trace (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, or manage.py)
expectations.evidence: ecosystem.language=python, ecosystem.framework=django, ecosystem.framework_version=4.2.7. detection_trace cites 'requirements.txt: Django==4.2.7' AND 'manage.py: Django command-line stub'.

expectations.text: Detects Django ORM — ecosystem.orm.profiles includes 'django' AND the detection trace names at least one extracted model class with its db_table mapping (e.g., Article → articles)
expectations.evidence: ecosystem.orm.profiles=[django]; detection_trace lists 'articles/models.py: Article(models.Model) -> db_table=articles' and 'Author(models.Model) -> db_table=authors'. orm_detect.js confirmed Article/articles, Author/authors.

expectations.text: Detects MongoDB — wiki.config.yaml's database block sets driver='mongodb' (via djongo or direct) with connection info parsed from settings.py (e.g., mongodb://localhost:27017)
expectations.evidence: ecosystem.database.driver=mongodb, via=djongo. environments.dev: host=localhost, port=27017, database=myappdb, connection_string_redacted=mongodb://localhost:27017. settings.py contains DATABASES['default'] CLIENT host='mongodb://localhost:27017'.

expectations.text: Policy stanza (block_ddl, block_privilege, dml_mode, audit.enabled) is populated for MongoDB
Wiki scaffold (wiki/, raw/, graph/, audit/, log/, outputs/) exists at the configured wiki_root
expectations.evidence: init_wiki.js created all 6 dirs at work/{wiki, raw, graph, audit, log, outputs} (audit has open/resolved subdirs).

expectations.text: Seed files (wiki/index.md, graph/edges.jsonl, log/events.jsonl) exist — not just empty directories
expectations.evidence: ls -la confirms work/wiki/index.md (frontmatter + body), work/graph/edges.jsonl (file present, can be empty), work/log/events.jsonl (contains init+onboard events).

eval_feedback.overall: All 6 expectations satisfied. Django + MongoDB stack correctly identified from requirements.txt, manage.py, settings.py, and articles/models.py; orm_detect.js extracted Article/Author entities with their db_table names.
